designs.config_zh: 现代炮塔、43年高速加农炮、自动装弹机、稳定器、易维护、无线电、扭力杆、柴油引擎；0引擎、20装甲。
designs.config_en: Modern turret, 1943 high-velocity cannon, autoloader, stabilizer, easy maintenance, radio, torsion bars and diesel; engine 0, armor 20.
designs.note_zh: 展示的是现代坦克；坦歼可沿用配件后切换角色，属性需重查。防空优先考虑基础中坦，避免现代底盘的额外投入。
designs.note_en: The panel is a modern tank. A TD can reuse its modules after a role change; recheck stats. For SPAA, prefer a basic medium to avoid modern-chassis costs.
designs.stats_en: Reliability 103.2%; armor 115.0; breakthrough 96.6; production cost 24.75.

designs.zh: 现代底盘：无甲自行火炮
designs.config_zh: 现代炮塔、重榴弹炮、自动装弹机、无线电、易维护、推土铲、台车式悬挂、汽油引擎；0引擎、0装甲。
designs.config_en: Modern turret, heavy howitzer, autoloader, radio, easy maintenance, dozer blade, bogie suspension and gasoline; engine 0, armor 0.
designs.note_zh: 按展示方案采用汽油引擎；叠满装甲的突破收益有限，此处不加装甲升级。
designs.note_en: This example uses gasoline. Maximum armor adds little breakthrough, so this version keeps armor upgrades at 0.
designs.stats_en: Speed 8.0; reliability 97.5%; soft attack 80.6; breakthrough 9.8; production cost 20.25.

designs.config_zh: 三成员炮塔、二级防空炮、易维护、装甲裙板、额外弹药架、二级无线电、交错负重轮、铆钉甲、柴油引擎；7引擎、14装甲。
designs.config_en: Three-man turret, level-2 AA gun, easy maintenance, side skirts, extra ammo, level-2 radio, interleaved wheels, riveted armor and diesel; engine 7, armor 14.
designs.note_zh: 独立的叠甲防空方案；与0甲版还存在配件、悬挂及引擎升级差异，属性变化不能全部归于装甲。
designs.note_en: A separate armored SPAA build. Modules, suspension and engine upgrades also differ from the armor-0 version; armor alone does not explain all stat changes.
designs.stats_en: Speed 4.4; reliability 63.3%; armor 64.6; air attack 48.0; production cost 12.25.

designs.zh: 基础中型：喷火坦克（支援连）
designs.config_zh: 三成员炮塔、二级喷火器、二级无线电、易维护、装甲裙板、额外弹药架、交错负重轮、铆钉甲、柴油引擎；7引擎、14装甲。
designs.config_en: Three-man turret, level-2 flamethrower, level-2 radio, easy maintenance, side skirts, extra ammo, interleaved wheels, riveted armor and diesel; engine 7, armor 14.
designs.note_zh: 用于喷火支援连。图中为喷火坦克（支援连）角色，不能按普通中型坦克成品的属性和用途理解。
designs.note_en: For a flame-tank support company. The panel uses the support-company flame role; do not treat its stats or purpose as those of a normal medium tank.
designs.stats_en: Speed 4.0; reliability 66.7%; armor 20.4; breakthrough 58.5; production cost 11.77.
